alterations.description: Deletion of the word "Sixty-three" from the first item "U.S. Airmen Free"
A shot of undressing on the bed, a woman being naked and a man amorously looking over her body
Some views of Doris Day singing in a negligee where the flesh of her bosom is prominently visible
From the item "Terror the words 'Rejoicing Arab advice not to go to Iraq, Lehad cancelled his visit to Egypt'"

alterations.description: From the item "American Airmen", the following words "Shot down during the Korean war, the airmen were reportedly found guilty of so-called act of provocation and ordered to be deported. A welcome change-of-heart that raises hope for the speedy return of U.S. Prisoners still held in China"
